item.title: 'Lee Myung-bak and Park Geun-hye' Come to Forefront of Election…Even Within PPP, "Negative Impact on Moderates" (‘이명박근혜’ 선거 전면에…국힘서도 “중도층 악영향”)
item.description:
Former Presidents Lee Myung-bak and Park Geun-hye jointly hit the campaign trail on the 31st to support candidates of the People Power Party (PPP) in the June 3 local elections. This move is interpreted as an attempt to consolidate conservative support, particularly in the competitive Yeongnam region. However, criticism is emerging both within and outside the party that it is inappropriate for the two former presidents—who were sentenced to prison time after facing judicial scrutiny and later pardoned—to join the election campaign. (이명박·박근혜 전 대통령이 31일 나란히 6·3 지방선거 국민의힘 후보 지원 유세에 나섰다. 판세가 팽팽히 맞서는 영남권을 중심으로 보수층 결집을 노린 행보로 풀이되지만, 사법적 심판을 받고 실형을 산 뒤 사면된 두 전직 대통령의 선거전 등판이 적절하지 않다는 비판이 당 안팎에서 나오고 있다.)

Former President Park Geun-hye visited Seomun Market in Jung-gu, Daegu, around 4 p.m. on this day alongside PPP Daegu mayoral candidate Choo Kyoung-ho, appealing for support. Park stated, "Candidate Choo is the right person to revive Daegu's economy. When Candidate Choo worked as Minister of the Office for Government Policy Coordination under my administration, we coordinated well, and he did an excellent job," adding, "Please give him overwhelming support." This marks Park's second campaign stop in Daegu, following a visit to Chilseong Market on the 23rd. She continued her support for Candidate Choo at Suseongmot Lake in Suseong-gu, Daegu. Starting in Daegu on the 23rd, Park has been traversing the country—including Daejeon, Okcheon and Gongju in Chungcheongbuk-do (25th), Jinju in Gyeongnam, Ulsan, and Busan (27th), Wonju in Gangwon (28th), and Changwon and Namhae in Gyeongnam (29th)—conducting campaign activities akin to a "election committee chairperson" level. <<> On the same day, former President Lee Myung-bak visited Busan to support PPP Busan mayoral candidate Park Hyung-joon. Candidate Park is a prominent figure from the pro-Lee faction, having served as Senior Secretary to the President for Public Relations and Senior Secretary for Political Affairs during the Lee Myung-bak administration. During a campaign rally at Haeundae Traditional Market in Haeundae-gu, Busan, around 1 p.m., Lee said, "Just as Seoul developed when I was its mayor, even as an opposition party mayor, Busan's future is determined not by who is president, but by who is its mayor. If Candidate Park serves four more years as mayor, Busan's population will grow, and young people and tourists will flock there." Earlier that morning, Lee visited Suryeong-ro Church in Haeundae-gu, worshiped alongside Candidate Park, and had pork soup. On the 15th, Lee had walked along Cheonggyecheon in Jung-gu, Seoul, with Seoul mayoral candidate Oh Se-hoon. <<> Skeptical voices are also prevalent within the party. A two-term lawmaker from the Yeongnam region told *The Hankyoreh*, "It might be effective in rallying traditional conservative supporters in Yeongnam and getting them to the polls," but added, "However, I question the scalability of their influence. It's uncertain whether they can draw moderates—the swing voters who decide election outcomes—to our side." A first-term lawmaker said, "The party leaning on a flawed past will not be good for us in the long run, as we need to move toward rebuilding conservatism." <<> The Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) strongly criticized the move. DPK leader Jung Cheong-rae, at a campaign rally in Gurye, South Jeolla Province, said, "Yoon, Lee, and Park are now roaming around," linking the "Yoon Again" forces within the PPP with former Presidents Park and Lee, calling them the "Three Prisoners." Jung continued, "This is a regression to the past, a distortion of democracy, and a disregard for the people." DPK Secretary General Cho Seung-rae also said at a press briefing at the National Assembly, "These are presidents who went to prison for corruption and were impeached and removed for abuse of power," adding, "A majority of reasonable citizens will not tolerate this." Political commentator Park Sang-byung told *The Hankyoreh*, "The former presidents have stepped to the forefront because they see it as an opportunity to recover their weakened political presence and restore their honor. Former presidents, as the nation's foremost elders, have a duty to present a national vision regardless of party affiliation, but engaging in election campaigns for the benefit of a specific political party is itself shameful." <<> Reported by Kim Hae-jung and Kim Chae-un, sea@hani.co.kr (박근혜 전 대통령은 이날 오후 4시께 추경호 국민의힘 대구시장 후보와 함께 대구 중구 서문시장을 찾아 지지를 호소했다. 박 전 대통령은 “추 후보는 대구 경제를 살리는 데 적임자다. 추 후보가 국무조정실장으로 일할 때 저와 호흡을 맞춰서 일했는데, 그때 참 일을 잘했다”며 “압도적 지지를 보내달라”고 했다. 박 전 대통령의 대구 지원 유세는 지난 23일 대구 칠성시장 방문에 이어 두번째다. 그는 대구 수성구 수성못에서도 추 후보 지원 유세를 이어갔다. 박 전 대통령은 지난 23일 대구를 시작으로, 대전, 충북 옥천·공주(25일), 경남 진주, 울산, 부산(27일), 강원 원주(28일), 경남 창원·남해(29일) 등 전국을 두루 돌며 ‘선거대책위원장급’ 지원 유세를 벌이고 있다.)

item.title: Jeong Won-oh: "End to Safety Insensitivity," Oh Se-hoon: "No Puppet Mayor"... Seoul's Blitz Campaigns (정원오 “안전불감 끝장” 오세훈 “허수아비 안돼”…서울 광폭 유세)
item.description:
On the final Sunday before the local election vote, May 31, both Jeong Won-oh, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Seoul mayor, and Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate, launched all-out campaigns. On this day, the two candidates traversed all of Seoul to appeal to voters, seeking to meet as many weekend voters who had taken to the streets as possible. (지방선거 본투표 전 마지막 일요일인 31일, 정원오 더불어민주당 서울시장 후보와 오세훈 국민의힘 후보가 총력전에 나섰다. 이날 두 후보는 주말을 맞아 거리로 나온 유권자들을 한명이라도 더 만나기 위해 서울 전 지역을 훑으며 표심을 호소했다.)

Candidate Jeong decided to hold a "One More Step, All the Way to the End" campaign over three days, starting from this day until midnight on June 2, when official electioneering ends. Jeong began his day with a service at Muhak Church in Seongdong-gu, then toured Yangcheon → Guro → Gangdong → Songpa → Seocho → Seodaemun → Seongdong. He visited Gocheok Sky Dome in Guro-gu, Seokchon Lake in Songpa-gu, and the Jamsu Bridge Festival site in Seocho-gu to meet voters. Both the start and end of the day's campaign were in Seongdong-gu. Jeong's camp explained this as "a sign of not forgetting his original commitment as the head of Seongdong-gu." (정 후보는 이날부터 공식 선거운동이 종료되는 6월2일 자정까지 3일간 ‘한걸음 더 끝까지 유세’를 펼치기로 했다. 정 후보는 이날 오전 성동구 무학교회 예배를 시작으로 양천 →구로 →강동 →송파 →서초 →서대문 →성동 등을 누볐다. 구로구 고척스카이 돔 , 송파구 석촌호수, 서초구 잠수교 축제 현장을 찾아 유권자들과 만났 다. 이날 유세의 시작과 끝은 모두 성동구였다. 정 후보 쪽은 “성동구청장으로서의 초심을 잃지 않겠다는 뜻”이라고 설명했다.)

Candidate Oh began his "88-Hour Vortex Infinite Campaign" at 8 a.m. on May 30. On this day alone, he sequentially toured Gwangjin → Gangdong → Songpa → Yongsan → Jongno → Seodaemun → Yeongdeungpo → Seocho. Starting with a campaign speech at Achasan in Gwangjin-gu, he met citizens at Gangdong Amsa General Market, Jamsil Baseball Stadium in Songpa-gu, Dongmyo Flea Market in Jongno-gu, and Times Square in Yeongdeungpo. Cho Eun-hee, the general election committee head for Oh's camp, explained the background for choosing these campaign locations: "The intent is to implement an integrated municipal administration responsible for citizens' entire life cycle—from housewives' livelihoods, to seniors' welfare, and to the future of youth." <<> On this day, Jeong highlighted the omission of rebar at the Samsung Station on the GTX-A line, repeatedly expressing concerns over Oh's "safety insensitivity." At the Gocheok Sky Dome campaign, Jeong emphasized, "Candidate Oh is acting as if the rebar omission at Samsung Station is someone else's problem, not his responsibility. We must change a mayor with safety insensitivity. Otherwise, accidents will continue to happen, and citizens will be so anxious they cannot lead their daily lives." <<> Candidate Oh brought up the theory of judging the government. Before his campaign on this day, Oh held a press conference at his Jongno-gu election office and stated, "Candidate Jeong, chosen by the president to become a candidate, will inevitably behave at a puppet level. Right now, Seoul needs a guardian of citizens' rights and interests, not a puppet." Oh added, "If you grant me the position of Seoul mayor once more, I will attend the State Council meeting immediately after my term begins, explain the 'Five Mandates of Seoul Citizens' in front of the president, and see them through." Oh mentioned normalizing conditions for redevelopment and reconstruction projects, revitalizing private rental housing supply, establishing preventive measures against real estate 'tax bombs,' easing metropolitan area regulations, and preventing the revocation of prosecutions. <<> Afterward, at a campaign event at Amsa Station in Gangdong-gu, Oh referenced a message posted by President Lee Jae-myung on X (formerly Twitter) the day before—"Abstaining from voting is not neutrality but siding with those who harm my life and our community"—and said, "Shouldn't a president at least say that they will embrace everyone and govern with politics? There's no way until two years later (when general elections are held) to make such a presidential mindset humble." <<> In response, at a campaign event at Gil-dong Bokjori Market in Gangdong-gu, Jeong raised his voice, saying, "The Seoul mayor's position is not about fighting with the president. A person who says they will fight the president to rebuild conservatism should not be elected. Can we just leave Candidate Oh, who aims to obstruct a competent president's work to fulfill his own political ambitions?" <<> Reporter Go Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (오 후보는 30일 아침 8시부터 ‘88시간 회오리 무한유세’를 펼치고 있다. 이날에만 광진→강동→송파→용산→종로→서대문→영등포→서초를 차례로 훑었다. 광진구 아차산 유세를 시작으로 강동 암사종합시장, 송파구 잠실야구장, 종로구 동묘 벼룩시장, 영등포 타임스퀘어 등에서 시민들과 만났다. 오 후보 캠프의 조은희 총괄선거대책본부장은 유세 장소를 택한 배경과 관련해 “주부의 민생, 어르신의 복지, 청년의 미래까지 시민의 전 생애주기를 책임지는 통합형 시정을 펼치겠다는 취지”라고 설명했다.)

item.title: Early Voting Rate Hits Record High: Ruling Party Says "Will to Judge Insurrection," Opposition Says "Expression of Regime Judgment" (사전투표율 역대 최고…여 “내란 심판 의지” 야 “정권 심판론 표출”)
item.description:
On the 31st, the ruling and opposition parties each interpreted the early voting rate (23.51%) for the June 3 local elections—which marked the highest ever for a local election—as a result favorable to themselves. The Democratic Party of Korea emphasized that it reflected "the people's will to judge the insurrection," while the People Power Party highlighted that it showed "judgment against the Democratic Party and the Lee Jae-myung regime." (여야가 31일 지방선거 사상 최고치를 기록한 6·3 지방선거 사전투표율(23.51%)을 두고 저마다 자신들에게 유리한 결과로 나타날 것이라는 해석을 내놨다. 더불어민주당은 “국민의 내란 심판 의지”가 드러난 것이라고 강조했고, 국민의힘은 “민주당과 이재명 정권 심판론”이 나타난 것이라고 부각했다.)

Kang Jun-hyun, senior spokesperson for the Democratic Party, said at a press conference at the National Assembly on the 31st, "It is not appropriate to discuss election advantages or disadvantages based on whether the early voting rate is high or low," but added, "It reflects the political judgment against the insurrection forces and the will to support the state affairs of the Lee Jae-myung government. It shows that the public has a tremendous interest in these local elections and parliamentary by-elections." Rep. Jeong Cheong-rae, the party's general election committee chairman, also told reporters on the 30th after a campaign rally in Hadong, South Gyeongsang Province, "Most of the people standing in line (at polling stations) are young people," adding, "If many young people came out, a high early voting rate is at least not unfavorable to the Democratic Party." (강준현 민주당 수석대변인은 31일 국회에서 기자회견을 열어 “사전투표율이 높고 낮음에 따라 선거 유불리를 말하는 것은 적절하지 않다”면서도 “내란 세력에 대한 정치적 심판과 이재명 정부 국정에 대한 뒷받침 의지가 반영된 것이다. 이번 지방선거나 국회의원 재보궐선거에 국민 관심이 지대하다는 걸 보여준다”고 말했다. 당 총괄상임선거대책위원장인 정청래 대표도 지난 30일 경남 하동 유세 뒤 기자들에게 “(투표장에) 줄 서 있는 분들이 대부분 젊은 층”이라며 “젊은 층이 많이 나왔다면 사전투표율이 높은 건 민주당에 적어도 불리하지 않다”고 말했다.)

The People Power Party said the result showed voters responding to "judgment against the arrogant government and ruling party." Senior spokesperson Choi Bo-yoon told reporters that day, "Given that the early voting rates in Daegu (18.65%) and North Gyeongsang Province (22.42%) were not high, we see that judgment against the Democratic Party and the Lee Jae-myung regime is taking place," adding, "If there were a strong judgment against the People Power Party in battlegrounds like Seoul and the Chungcheong region, the early voting rate should have been high, but that trend did not emerge." (국민의힘은 유권자들이 ‘오만한 정부·여당 심판론’에 호응한 결과라고 했다. 최보윤 수석대변인은 이날 기자들과 만나 “대구(18.65%)·경북(22.42%) 사전투표율이 높지 않았다는 점에서 민주당과 이재명 정권에 대한 심판이 이뤄지고 있다고 보고 있다”며 “서울과 충청권 등 격전지에서 국민의힘에 대한 심판론이 높다면 사전투표율이 높게 나왔어야 했는데 그런 흐름이 아니었다”고 말했다.)

Rep. Jang Dong-hyuk also said at a press briefing, "The early voting rate has risen, and I think the main election turnout should also increase so that the people's anger judging the arrogance of Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party translates into votes." Election committee chief Jeong Hee-yong said in a statement on the 30th, "The high early voting rate is a strong warning from the people against arrogant power that disregards public opinion," adding, "Citizens angered by attempts to cancel trials to erase the president's crimes, citizens frustrated by the fading dream of owning a home, and citizens and provincial residents who felt they could not entrust their regions to unqualified and unverified candidates headed to the polls." (장동혁 대표도 기자 간담회에서 “사전투표율 높아졌는데 본투표 투표율도 높아져서 이재명과 민주당의 오만함을 심판하는 국민의 분노가 표로 이어져야 된다고 생각한다”고 말했다. 정희용 선거대책본부장은 지난 30일 입장문에서 “높은 사전투표율은 국민 눈치 보지 않는 오만한 권력을 향한 국민의 강력한 경고”라며 “대통령의 죄를 지우기 위한 재판 취소 시도에 분노한 국민, 멀어져 가는 내 집 마련 꿈에 좌절한 국민, 자격도 능력도 검증되지 않은 후보들에게 지역을 맡길 수 없다고 생각한 시민과 도민들께서 투표장으로 향했다”고 말했다.)

However, both inside and outside the political world believe that the record-high early voting rate will not necessarily lead directly to a record-high final turnout. (다만 정치권 안팎에서는 역대 최고 사전투표율이 곧바로 역대 최고 최종 투표율로 이어지지는 않을 거라고 보고 있다.)

Park Sung-min, head of the political consulting firm "Min," told The Hankyoreh, "Since the introduction of early voting in 2014, the early voting rate has been steadily increasing. As the early voting system becomes established, the total number of votes is being spread out," adding, "It's simply a matter of the voting period being divided into three days." Rep. Jeong Cheong-rae also said at the Hadong rally, "There is also a perspective that because voters tend to 'handle other errands on main election day,' the early voting rate has naturally increased. I agree with that perspective as well." (박성민 ‘정치컨설팅 민’ 대표는 한겨레에 “2014년 사전투표 도입 이후 사전투표율은 계속 늘어나고 있다. 사전투표제가 정착됨에 따라 전체 투표수가 분산되고 있는 것”이라며 “단순히 투표일이 3일로 나뉜 거라 보면 된다”고 했다. 정청래 대표도 하동 유세에서 “‘본투표일에 다른 볼일 보자’라는 (유권자) 경향성이 있어서 사전투표가 자연스레 높아졌다는 관점도 있다. 이런 관점에도 동의한다”고 말했다.)

Reporters Kim Chae-woon and Yoo Young-jae cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 유영재 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Boo-kyum’s ‘Wall-Knocking’ Campaign…Choo Kyung-ho Appears with Park Geun-hye (김부겸, ‘벽치기 유세’…추경호는 박근혜 함께)
item.description:
On the 31st, three days before the main vote in the June 3 local elections, Kim Boo-kyum, the Democratic Party candidate for Daegu mayor—considered the biggest battleground—and Choo Kyung-ho, the People Power Party candidate, toured Daegu to rally support. Kim deployed his signature ‘wall-knocking’ campaign as a final gambit, while Choo, following a similar move on the 23rd, once again visited a market with former President Park Geun-hye to consolidate conservative support. (6·3 지방선거 최대 격전지로 꼽히는 대구시장 선거에 나선 김부겸 더불어민주당 후보와 추경호 국민의힘 후보가 본투표 사흘 전인 31일 대구 곳곳을 돌며 지지를 호소했다. 김 후보는 자신의 ‘상징’인 이른바 벽치기 유세로 막판 승부수를 띄웠고, 추 후보는 지난 23일에 이어 또 한번 박근혜 전 대통령과 시장을 찾아 보수층 결집을 노렸다.)

That day, Kim began his first campaign stop at the dawn market in Dalseong Park, Jung-gu. He then conducted a wall-knocking campaign at apartment complexes in Bongmu-dong, Dong-gu. The term ‘wall-knocking campaign’ originated from Kim’s practice in Daegu, where crowds are sparse at rally sites, of canvassing every corner of apartment complexes and alleys and delivering speeches as if talking to a wall. At Kim’s campaign site that day, Kang Hyo-sang, honorary election committee chairperson and former Saenuri Party lawmaker who recently joined Kim’s camp, accompanied him, stating, “(Kim) is the only hope to revive Daegu.” Regarding the early voting on the 29th and 30th, where Daegu recorded a turnout of 18.65%, up from 14.80% four years ago, Kim’s joint election committee chairperson, Kwon Chil-seung, said, “This is the result of a collective desire for Daegu, which has been stagnant, to seize new opportunities for change and development through Kim.” <<> Choo also began his day at the dawn market in Dalseong Park. In the afternoon, he visited Seomun Market in Jung-gu with former President Park. During his campaign, Choo said, “Those who said they’d vote on the main day because they’re worried about early voting must come out to the polls,” urging his supporters to show their backing. <<> Former President Park, appearing in a black blouse and jeans, said, “Seomun Market is a symbolic place for conservatism,” and added, “Seeing you all, even though I’m a bit tired, I feel my energy renewed.” She continued, “I know well that these days, Daegu’s economy is struggling and you’re all going through a lot,” and remarked, “I believe our candidate Choo Kyung-ho will revive Daegu’s economy and repay you.” <<> By Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr and Kim Hae-jeong sea@hani.co.kr (이날 김 후보는 대구 중구 달성공원 새벽시장에서 첫 유세를 시작했다. 동구 봉무동 아파트단지 등에선 벽치기 유세에 나섰다. 벽치기 유세는 김 후보가 유세장에 사람이 잘 모이지 않는 대구에서 아파트단지나 골목 구석구석을 훑으며 마치 벽을 보고 이야기하듯 연설한 것을 두고 생긴 표현이다. 이날 김 후보의 유세 현장에는 최근 김 후보 캠프에 합류한 강효상 명예선거대책위원장(전 새누리당 의원)이 동행해 “(김 후보가) 대구를 살리는 유일한 희망”이라고 말했다. 김 후보 캠프의 권칠승 공동선대위원장은 지난 29~30일 사전투표에서 대구가 4년 전(14.80%)보다 높은 투표율(18.65%)을 기록한 것에 대해서는 “김 후보를 통해 그동안 침체된 대구가 새로운 변화와 발전의 계기를 마련하기를 바라는 마음이 뭉쳐진 결과”라고 했다.)

item.title: “Why is Ha Jung-woo trying to fight ordinary citizens?”…“A Han Dong-hoon supporter assaulted a resident” (“하정우, 왜 일반시민과 싸우려하나”…“한동훈 지지자가 주민 폭행”)
item.description:

item.title: “Lee Myung-bak and Park Geun-hye’s Return is Political Regression” vs “Judgment on the Lee Jae-myung Administration” (“이명박근혜 등판, 정치퇴행” vs “이재명 정부 심판”)
item.description:
Three days before the June 3 local elections and National Assembly by-elections, the ruling and opposition parties on the 31st each focused on rallying their support bases, championing “stabilizing the Lee Jae-myung administration” and “judging an arrogant government.” The two parties engaged in sharp exchanges over former Presidents Lee Myung-bak and Park Geun-hye’s campaign support for People Power Party candidates and President Lee Jae-myung’s push for voter turnout, respectively accusing each other of “political regression” and “election interference.” (6·3 지방선거와 국회의원 재보궐선거 사흘 전인 31일 여야는 각각 ‘이재명 정부 안정론’과 ‘오만한 정부 심판론’을 내세우며 지지층 결집에 총력을 쏟았다. 여야는 이명박·박근혜 전 대통령의 국민의힘 후보 지원 유세와 이재명 대통령의 투표 독려를 두고 각각 “정치 퇴행”과 “선거 개입”이라며 날 선 공방을 벌였다.)

The Democratic Party, taking to the streets for the final weekend of campaigning before the election, put President Lee at the forefront to appeal to its support base to turn out and vote. (선거 전 마지막 주말 유세에 나선 더불어민주당은 이 대통령을 전면에 내세워 지지층의 투표 참여를 호소했다.)

Jeong Cheong-rae, chair of the party’s general election steering committee, toured various locations in South Jeolla’s Gurye and North and South Chungcheong provinces on the same day, telling crowds at every campaign site, “If you want to support the president, please cast your vote for Candidate No. 1 during early voting.” At a rally in Gurye, Jeong emphasized, “If you like President Lee, want to support him, and give him strength, please make sure to vote for Candidate No. 1, the candidate from the Democratic Party, the party President Lee belongs to.” (총괄상임선거대책위원장인 정청래 대표는 이날 전남 구례와 충북·충남 곳곳을 돌며 유세 현장마다 “대통령을 밀어주겠다면 기호 1번을 찍어달라”고 말했다. 정 대표는 구례 유세에서 “이 대통령을 좋아하고 이 대통령을 밀어주고 싶고, 힘을 실어주고 싶다면 이 대통령이 속한 정당인 민주당의 기호 1번 후보를 꼭 뽑아달라”고 강조했다.)

In contrast, the People Power Party highlighted the idea of rendering judgment on the Lee Jae-myung administration. (반면 국민의힘은 이재명 정부 심판론을 부각했다.)

Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk held a press conference at the party’s central headquarters in Yeouido, Seoul, stating, “As a price for being indifferent to politics in the last general and presidential elections, the worst and low-quality Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party are dominating South Korea,” and called for “stopping Lee Jae-myung’s rampage through voting.” (장동혁 대표는 서울 여의도 중앙당사에서 기자회견을 열어 “지난 총선과 대선에서 정치에 무관심했던 대가로 최악의 저질 이재명과 민주당이 대한민국을 지배하고 있다”며 “투표로 이재명의 폭주를 멈춰 세우자”고 말했다.)

Former Presidents Park Geun-hye and Lee Myung-bak each toured Daegu and Busan, participating in campaign support for People Power Party candidates. (박근혜, 이명박 전 대통령은 각각 대구와 부산을 돌며 국민의힘 후보 지원 유세에 나섰다.)

Former President Park visited Daegu, the biggest battleground in the local elections, and held rallies with the People Power Party’s Daegu mayoral candidate Choo Kyung-ho at Seomun Market and Suseong Pond. Park was touring most of the country excluding Seoul, the capital area, and the Honam region. Former President Lee also visited Busan on the same day to support People Power Party Busan mayoral candidate Park Hyung-joon and Park Min-sik, the candidate for the Busan North Gap by-election for the National Assembly. (박 전 대통령은 지방선거 최대 격전지인 대구를 찾아 추경호 국민의힘 대구시장 후보와 서문시장과 수성못 등에서 유세를 벌였다. 박 전 대통령은 서울, 수도권과 호남을 뺀 전국 대부분 지역을 돌고 있다. 이 전 대통령도 이날 부산을 찾아 박형준 국민의힘 부산시장 후보와 박민식 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 후보를 지원했다.)

The People Power Party anticipates that the full-fledged campaign support from the two former presidents will help consolidate the conservative base. (국민의힘은 두 전직 대통령의 전면적인 지원 유세가 보수층 결집에 도움이 될 것으로 기대한다.)

In response, party leader Jeong Cheong-rae criticized at the Gurye rally, “The era of President Lee Jae-myung has arrived, but the ‘three jailbirds’—former Presidents Yoon Suk-yeol, Lee Myung-bak, and Park Geun-hye—are roaming around. The commonality among these three former presidents is that they are either in or have been to prison. This (their activities) is a regression to the past, a distortion of democracy, and an insult to the people.” (이에 정청래 대표는 구례 유세에서 “이재명 대통령의 시대가 왔는데 감옥 3인방, 윤석열·이명박·박근혜 전 대통령이 돌아다니고 있다”며 “세 전직 대통령의 공통점은 감옥에 있거나 감옥에 갔다 온 것이다. 이것(이들의 활동)은 과거 퇴행이고 민주주의 왜곡이고 국민 무시”라고 비판했다.)

Amid this, President Lee Jae-myung repeatedly encouraged voting on X (formerly Twitter), posting, “In a democratic republic, the silence and renunciation of voting by sovereign citizens give opportunities to those who deceive the people, abuse power for personal gain, and ruin the lives of me and my family” (May 31) and “Giving up voting is not neutral; it’s siding with those who harm my life and the community” (May 30). In response, the People Power Party strongly pushed back: “As the election landscape becomes unfavorable, he’s dividing the people. Isn’t Lee Jae-myung himself a malicious ruler?” (Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk). (이런 가운데 이재명 대통령은 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 “민주공화국에서 주권자의 침묵과 투표 포기는 국민을 속이고 사익을 위해 권력을 남용하며 나와 가족의 삶을 망치는 자들에게 기회를 주는 것”(31일) “투표 포기는 중립이 아니라 내 삶과 공동체를 해치는 그들을 편드는 것”(30일)이라며 거듭 투표를 독려했다. 이에 국민의힘은 “선거판이 불리해지자 국민을 갈라치기하고 있다. 이재명 본인이 악성 지배자 아니냐”(장동혁 대표)라고 강하게 반발했다.)

Reporters: Choi Ha-yan, Yoo Young-jae, and Seo Young-ji chy@hani.co.kr (최하얀 유영재 서영지 기자 chy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Middle East, Ukraine Wars Amid Trump Crisis… Korea and Europe Must Strengthen Ties" (“트럼프 위기에 중동·우크라 전쟁까지…한-유럽 더 결속해야”)
item.description:
The recent visit to South Korea by the European Parliament's Delegation for Relations with the Korean Peninsula (DKOR), which handles Korean Peninsula issues in Europe, came three years and eight months after the outbreak of the Ukraine war in September 2022. This period also saw strengthened North Korea-Russia ties following the Ukraine war, tariff wars under U.S. President Donald Trump, and the Middle East crisis in Gaza and Iran, all impacting both South Korea and Europe. (유럽에서 한반도 문제를 다루는 유럽의회 한반도관계대표단(DKOR)의 최근 한국 방문은 우크라이나 전쟁이 발발한 2022년 9월 이후 3년8개월 만이다. 우크라이나 전쟁 이후 강화된 북한-러시아의 밀착과 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령의 관세 전쟁, 가자지구와 이란에서 발생한 중동 위기가 한국과 유럽을 휩쓴 시간이기도 하다.)

César Luena, head of the Delegation for Relations with the Korean Peninsula, said in a meeting with The Hankyoreh at Lotte Hotel in Jung-gu, Seoul on March 29 that he is paying attention to the relationship between the U.S. and its allies in the 'Trump era.' "We have witnessed a new, aggressive trade policy from the United States, and Europe and South Korea have responded in a similar manner," Luena said. "South Korea appears to be defending its own interests not only in trade but also in terms of security in the Indo-Pacific region." <<> He added that during a meeting with Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul on March 28, they discussed response strategies to the Trump administration. "We agreed that even if governments change, society and the state continue, and both South Korea and the European Union, as allies sharing values beyond economic ties with the U.S., must deal with the Trump administration with great patience," he said. <<> In the interview, Luena criticized the U.S.-Israel-Iran war as an "illegal attack" committed by President Trump. "Both the Eastern and Western Hemispheres are affected by the Strait of Hormuz, and we should not have any dependency relationships that could jeopardize Europe's independence and sovereignty," he said, emphasizing the need for energy transition for energy and economic security and the environment. <<> Regarding North Korea becoming an ally of Russia and intervening in the Ukraine war, the European Parliament's stance on North Korea's nuclear issue was firm. "We uphold complete denuclearization, which must be irreversible," Luena stated, expressing that recognizing North Korea as a nuclear state is unacceptable. <<> Amid multi-layered crises shaking South Korea and Europe, Luena emphasized solidarity among democratic nations. Noting that Trump denied the 2020-2021 election results and his supporters occupied the Capitol yet he was re-elected, Luena said, "South Korea survived the (former President Yoon Suk Yeol's) martial law attempt, and the perpetrator ended up in prison. South Korea has become a role model for democracy." <<> The Delegation for Relations with the Korean Peninsula, comprising 26 European Parliament members from nine EU member states, visited the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Unification, and the National Assembly from March 27 to 29, discussing issues facing both Korea and Europe, including the Middle East situation, the Ukraine war, supply chains, and North Korea-Russia issues. <<> Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr ( 세자르 루에나 한반도관계대표단 단장은 지난달 29일 서울 중구 롯데호텔에서 한겨레와 만나 ‘트럼프 시대’ 미국과 동맹의 관계에 주목한다고 했다. 루에나 단장은 “우리는 미국의 새롭고 공격적인 무역 정책을 목도했고, 유럽과 한국은 비슷한 방식으로 대응해 왔다”며 “한국은 무역 뿐 아니라 인도-태평양 지역의 안보 차원에서도 자국 이익을 위해 방어하고 있는 것으로 보인다”고 평가했다. )

item.title: Why Honam's Early Voting Rate Soared to Three Times the National Average (‘전국 평균 3배’ 호남 사전투표율이 치솟은 이유)
item.description:
The early voting rate in the Honam region for the June 3 local elections surged compared to four years ago. Regarding this, within the Democratic Party of Korea, there are analyses that the ruling party's support base consolidated due to a sense of crisis as battleground districts between the ruling and opposition parties increased nationwide, along with interpretations that the noise during the nomination process in the Honam region had an impact. (6·3 지방선거 호남 지역 사전투표율이 4년 전에 견줘 급상승했다. 이를 두고 더불어민주당 안팎에서는 전국적으로 여야 간 접전 지역이 늘어나자 위기감을 느낀 여당 지지층이 결집했다는 분석과, 호남 지역 공천 과정에서의 잡음이 영향을 미쳤다는 해석이 함께 나온다.)

According to the results of early voting conducted on the 29th and 30th, South Jeolla recorded 38.95%, North Jeolla 35.05%, and Gwangju 27.83%. Compared to four years ago, South Jeolla rose by 7.91 percentage points, North Jeolla by 10.64 percentage points, and Gwangju by 10.55 percentage points, far exceeding the national average increase of 2.9 percentage points. In the 2022 local elections, South Jeolla recorded an early voting rate of 31.04%, North Jeolla 24.41%, and Gwangju 17.28%. <<> Within and outside the Democratic Party, there is talk that the nomination issue in the Honam region is not unrelated to the sharp rise in early voting rates. The Democratic Party excluded candidate Kim Gwan-yeong, who was embroiled in allegations of distributing cash envelopes, from nominations and expelled him from the party, but there was considerable backlash. On the 30th, Song Young-gil, the Democratic Party candidate for the by-election in Incheon's Yeonsu-gu Gap district, caused a stir by saying, "Candidate Kim Gwan-yeong was also chosen by President Lee Jae-myung." On the 31st, Kim said, "This early voting rate is a stern accountability imposed by the provincial residents for the arrogance of thinking that the central party leadership can decide candidates instead of the will of the people," adding, "It was an expression of self-respect that North Jeolla is never a voting machine for the leadership of Jeong Cheong-rae." A Democratic Party lawmaker from the Honam region also told The Hankyoreh, "In South Jeolla and Gwangju, there are many complaints that Representative Jeong Cheong-rae interfered in the nominations of basic local government heads and regional councilors." In response, Democratic Party Senior Spokesperson Kang Jun-hyeon said, "North Jeolla residents have a significant interest in the current situation. However, they will pursue practical benefits for the development of North Jeolla," expressing expectations for the victory of Democratic Party North Jeolla Governor candidate Lee Won-taek. <<> On the other hand, some analyses suggested that as election day approaches, conservatives are consolidating, leading Honam voters to rally together. A two-term lawmaker from the Honam region explained to The Hankyoreh, "As the conservative support base uniting is becoming evident in many areas across the country, Honam residents are gathering together." <<> Reporter Kim Chae-un cwk@hani.co.kr ( 지난 29∼30일 실시된 사전투표 결과 전남은 38.95%, 전북은 35.05%, 광주는 27.83%의 사전투표율을 기록했다. 4년 전에 견줘 전남은 7.91%포인트, 전북은 10.64%포인트, 광주는 10.55%포인트나 오른 수치로, 전국 평균 상승률(2.9%포인트)을 훌쩍 웃돈다. 2022년 지방선거에서 전남은 31.04%, 전북은 24.41%, 광주는 17.28%의 사전투표율을 기록한 바 있다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Illegal Real Estate Speculation and Tax Evasion Must Stop" (이 대통령 “부동산 불법투기 탈세 이젠 안 돼”)
item.description:
<<>> President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 1st, "Illegal real estate speculation and tax evasion are no longer acceptable," adding, "We will definitely escape from this ruinous republic of real estate unearned income." ()

The President shared this in a post on X (formerly Twitter), along with a media report indicating that reports of real estate tax evasion were concentrated in the Seoul metropolitan area. According to data submitted by the National Tax Service to People's Party Representative Cha Gyu-geun of the National Assembly's Strategy and Finance Committee, out of 780 tax evasion reports filed between November of last year and March, 633 were concentrated in metropolitan jurisdictions such as Seoul, the central region, and Incheon. The Real Estate Tax Evasion Reporting Center was established to root out tax evasion, including disguised gifts and false contracts arising in real estate transactions, and offers rewards of up to 4 billion won depending on the amount of evaded taxes. ( 이재명 대통령이 1일 “부동산 불법투기 탈세 이제는 안 된다”라며 “망국적인 부동산 불로소득 공화국은 반드시 탈출할 것”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: Is Han Dong-hoon the 'Bad Person' MB Referred To? Inner Circle Calls It "Absurd" (MB가 말한 ‘나쁜 사람’이 한동훈?…친한계 “황당”)
item.description:
When Park Min-sik, the People Power Party candidate for the by-election in Busan's Buk-gu district, claimed that former President Lee Myung-bak's "bad person" remark referred to his competitor, independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, Han's camp pushed back. (박민식 국민의힘 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 후보가 이명박 전 대통령의 “나쁜 사람” 발언은 경쟁자인 한동훈 무소속 후보를 지칭한 것이라고 주장하자 한 후보 쪽이 반발했다.)

In a Facebook post on the 31st, Park stated: "Today, President Lee Myung-bak firmly grasped my hand and emphasized twice, three times: 'Fight to the end. Good people fighting bad people must win. You will surely win.'" (박 후보는 지난 31일 페이스북에 올린 글에서 “‘끝까지 싸워라. 선한 사람이 나쁜 사람하고 싸우면 이겨야지. 반드시 이길 것이다’(라고) 오늘 이명박 대통령님께서 제 손을 꽉 잡으시고 힘주어 두 번 세 번 말씀하셨다”고 말했다.)

Park added, "This was not mere encouragement. It is a stern command from our conservative supporters to defeat someone who has shaken conservative values," and "It is an earnest wish for that person, who has put our People Power Party through hard times and brought joy to the Democratic Party of Korea, to face judgment." (박 후보는 이어 “(이는) 단순한 격려가 아니었다. 보수의 가치를 흔든 사람을 반드시 이겨달라는 우리 보수 지지자들의 준엄한 명령이다”라며 “우리 국민의힘이 어려운 시간을 보내게 하고 더불어민주당에 환희를 안겨준 사람을 심판받도록 하라는 간절한 바람”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Although he did not directly name Han, the context implied him. Park also wrote, "It is a command to stop the Democratic Party's rampage, which is shaking Busan and Buk-gu, right here in Buk-gu's Gap district." (한 후보를 직접 거론하진 않았지만, 맥락상 그를 언급한 것이다. 박 후보는 “또 부산을 흔들고 북구를 흔드는 민주당의 폭주를 이곳 북구갑에서 반드시 멈춰 세우라는 명령이다”라고도 했다.)

Park emphasized, "Bad politics tries to kill people with numbers, but good politics wins with people's hearts. For conservatism to rise again, to gather scattered hearts, Park Min-sik must win in Buk-gu Gap." (박 후보는 “나쁜 정치는 숫자로 사람을 죽이려 하지만 선한 정치는 사람의 마음으로 이긴다”며 “보수가 다시 일어서기 위해, 흩어진 마음을 다시 모으기 위해, 북구갑에서 박민식이 반드시 이겨야 한다”고 강조했다.)

In response, Han's camp reacted sharply. Kim Jong-hyuk, a former People Power Party supreme council member close to Han, said on Facebook that day: "A person who accompanied former President Lee on his trip to Busan today contacted me. He said, 'When MB said good people fight bad people and win, it meant winning against the Democratic Party. But Park is absurdly claiming that MB said he himself is good and Han Dong-hoon is a bad candidate.'" (이에 한 후보 쪽은 발끈했다. 친한동훈계인 김종혁 전 국민의힘 최고위원은 이날 페이스북에서 “이 전 대통령을 수행해 오늘 부산에 내려갔던 분이 연락해 왔다. ‘엠비(MB)가 선한 사람과 나쁜 사람이 싸우니 이기라고 한 건 민주당에 이기라는 뜻이었는데 박 후보가 마치 자신은 선하고 한동훈은 나쁜 후보라고 엠비가 말한 것처럼 얘기해 황당하다’는 것”이라고 했다.)

Kim further stated, "The person who accompanied Lee also added, 'MB went there to cheer for Mayor Park Hyung-joon, not for Park Min-sik. But Park kept trying to take photos with MB and forcibly sat next to him at the restaurant.'" Kim then asked, "No matter how desperate you are, isn't it too embarrassing to go this far?" (김 전 최고위원은 “그러면서 ‘엠비는 박형준 시장을 응원하러 간 것이지 박민식 후보는 상관없는데 자꾸 엠비와 사진 찍으려고 하고 식당에서도 억지로 옆자리에 앉았다’고 (수행했던 사람이) 덧붙였다”며 “아무리 다급해도 이렇게까지 하는 건 너무 쪽팔리지 않냐”고 말했다.)

Former President Lee, wearing a red jacket, visited Busan that day and urged citizens to support the People Power Party candidate. (이 전 대통령은 이날 빨간색 점퍼를 입고 부산을 찾아 시민들을 향해 국민의힘 후보 지지를 독려했다.)

Reporter Song Kyung-hwa freehwa@hani.co.kr (송경화 기자 freehwa@hani.co.kr)

item.description:
On June 1, two days ahead of the June 3 local and by-elections, the Democratic Party of Korea and the People Power Party vowed an all-out effort to secure even one more vote, urging voter participation. (6·3 지방선거와 재보궐선거를 이틀 앞둔 1일, 더불어민주당과 국민의힘은 한 표라도 더 얻기 위한 총력전을 다짐하며 투표 참여를 호소했다.)

item.title: Yoo Young-ha: "Park Geun-hye, like King Danjong's restoration... The phrase 'Lass, I am the plum blossom' lingers in my mind" (유영하 “박근혜, 단종처럼 복위…‘소녀, 매화이옵니다’ 입에 맴돈다”)
item.description:
Yoo Young-ha, a lawmaker from the People Power Party, claimed about former President Park Geun-hye that "just like King Danjong, who was restored from Prince Nosan, the yoke of lies and slander placed upon her will surely be removed, and she will be restored to her rightful place." Representative Yoo is one of Park's closest confidants. (유영하 국민의힘 의원이 박근혜 전 대통령을 두고 “노산군에서 복위된 단종처럼 거짓과 모함으로 덧씌워진 멍에는 반드시 벗겨지고 제 자리로 복위될 것”이라고 주장했다. 유 의원은 박 전 대통령의 최측근이다.)

In a Facebook post on the 1st, Rep. Yoo said, "Truth cannot be confined or hidden," adding this statement. He also said that "restoration" is "the last mission left for me" and that "even if it's slow, I must go on without giving up until the end." (유 의원은 1일 페이스북에 “진실은 가둬지지 않고 숨겨지지도 않는다”며 이렇게 말했다. 유 의원은 ‘복위’가 “내게 남은 마지막 소명”이라며 “더디더라도 끝까지 포기하지 않고 가야만 한다”고도 했다.)

Referring to his campaign rally support for Choo Kyung-ho, the People Power Party's mayoral candidate in Daegu, alongside former President Park at places like Seomun Market in Daegu the previous day, Rep. Yoo said, "I also felt just as sorry, having to inevitably block the hands that reached out with all their might just to touch her hand once." (유 의원은 전날 박 전 대통령과 대구 서문시장 등을 돌며 추경호 국민의힘 대구시장 후보 지원 유세를 한 것을 언급하며 “(박 전 대통령의) 손 한 번 만져보기 위해서 있는 힘을 다해 뻗는 손들을 어쩔 수 없이 막아내야 했던 나도 안쓰럽기는 매한가지”라고 말했다.)

Rep. Yoo stated, "Even today, her hands are grabbed, and she is pulled by the shoulder, causing her pain. As soon as she arrived at her private residence, she received emergency treatment, and I could only tell her to rest starting tomorrow. Yesterday, she endured with an IV drip, but now all her energy must be exhausted." He added, "I felt that the shouts of so many people we saw today were an expression of regret for not being able to protect the president." (유 의원은 “(박 전 대통령은) 오늘도 손이 잡히고, 어깨까지 잡아당겨져서 통증이 있다고 하신다. 사저에 도착하시자마자 응급치료를 하시고 내일부터 안정을 취하시라는 말씀밖에 달리 드릴 말씀이 없었다”며 “어제도 링거를 맞고 버티셨는데 이젠 모든 에너지가 소진되셨을 것”이라고 했다. 이어 “오늘 보여준 그 많은 분들의 외침은 대통령님을 지켜주지 못했다는 미안함이라고 나는 느꼈다”고 말했다.)

Rep. Yoo added, "Those who subjected her to public humiliation and danced a cruel knife dance, committing character assassination, will surely pay the price, and that day is not far off." (유 의원은 “그대들이 했던 조리돌림과 잔인한 칼춤을 추면서 자행했던 인격 살인에 대한 대가는 꼭 받을 것이고, 그날이 멀지 않았다”고 덧붙였다.)

On the 28th of last month, Rep. Yoo also said on Facebook, "When President Park Chung-hee passed away, I saw the plum tree of loyalty at Cheongungak, which shed two petals and then withered. It makes me wonder if it's a coincidence that the court lady who remained loyal to King Danjong until the end in the hottest recent movie, 'The Man Who Lives with the King,' is named Maehwa (Plum Blossom)." Rep. Yoo added, "Loyalty remains unchanged through the ages," and "The line 'Lass, I am the plum blossom' lingers around my lips." (유 의원은 지난달 28일에도 페이스북에서 “박정희 대통령께서 서거하셨을 때 꽃잎 두 잎을 피운 후 고사한, 청운각 충절의 매화나무를 보면서 최근 가장 핫한 영화인 ‘왕과 사는 남자’에서 단종의 마지막까지 지킨 궁녀 이름이 매화인 것이 우연인가 싶다”고 말하기도 했다. 유 의원은 “충절은 시대를 지나도 그 뜻은 변하지 않는다”며 “‘소녀, 매화이옵니다’라는 대사가 입 주위를 맴돈다”고 했다.)

Former President Park was sentenced by the Supreme Court to 22 years in prison, a fine of 18 billion won, and an additional penalty of 3.5 billion won for charges including the "confidante power abuse" scandal and illegally receiving special activity funds from the National Intelligence Service. She served 4 years and 9 months before being released in December 2021 through a special pardon by former President Moon Jae-in. Starting from Daegu on the 23rd, former President Park has been touring nationwide, including Daejeon and Okcheon and Gongju in North Chungcheong Province (25th), Jinju in South Gyeongsang Province, Ulsan, and Busan (27th), Wonju in Gangwon Province (28th), and Changwon and Namhae in South Gyeongsang Province (29th), conducting campaign support at the "election committee chairperson level" for the People Power Party. This marks the first time former President Park has appeared at campaign rally sites since being impeached from the presidency in 2017. (박 전 대통령은 비선 실세 국정농단 사건과 국가정보원 특수활동비 상납 등의 혐의로 징역 22년과 벌금 180억원, 추징금 35억원이 대법원에서 확정돼 4년9개월간 복역하다가 문재인 전 대통령의 특별사면으로 2021년 12월 풀려났다. 박 전 대통령은 지난 23일 대구를 시작으로, 대전, 충북 옥천·공주(25일), 경남 진주, 울산, 부산(27일), 강원 원주(28일), 경남 창원·남해(29일) 등 전국을 두루 돌며 국민의힘 ‘선거대책위원장급’ 지원 유세를 벌이고 있다. 박 전 대통령이 선거 유세 현장에 모습을 보인 것은 2017년 대통령직에서 탄핵당한 이후 이번이 처음이다.)

Song Kyung-hwa, Reporter freehwa@hani.co.kr (송경화 기자 freehwa@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Lee Jae-myung on 'KOSPI 4100 Excluding Semiconductors' Controversy: "Why Exclude a Core Industry? It's Actually Amazing" (이재명, ‘반도체 제외 4100’ 논란에 “왜 핵심 산업 빼나…오히려 대단”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung on the 1st shared an article stating that if semiconductors are excluded, the KOSPI index would be 4100, and said, "Semiconductors are one of the core industries of our country, so I don't quite understand why we need to calculate the composite stock index excluding them." (이재명 대통령이 1일 반도체를 빼면 코스피 지수가 4100이라는 기사를 공유하며 “반도체가 우리 산업의 핵심 중 하나인데 왜 반도체를 빼고 종합주가지수를 계산해야 하는지 이해가 잘 안 된다”고 말했다.)

On that day, President Lee shared an article on X (formerly Twitter) with the headline 'Market in Illusion... If You Exclude Semiconductors, KOSPI Barely at 4100.' The article reported that an analysis showed the actual KOSPI index, excluding semiconductor sectors like Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, only stood at 4100-4200. In response, President Lee said, "'If you take away his soccer skills, Son Heung-min is just an ordinary person?' No one says that. item.title: President Lee: "Mobilize all resources for rescue and response to Hanwha Aerospace accident" (이 대통령 “한화에어로스페이스 사고, 인명 구조에 총동원 대처”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung was briefed on the explosion accident at Hanwha Aerospace's Daejeon plant on the 1st and ordered "the mobilization of all available resources for rescue and accident response." (이재명 대통령이 1일 한화에어로스페이스 대전공장에서 발생한 폭발 사고를 보고 받고 “인명 구조와 사고 수습에 가용한 자원을 총동원해 대처할 것”을 지시했다.)

Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yoo-jung stated that day, "President Lee ordered a thorough investigation into the cause of the accident and the establishment of measures to prevent recurrence." At 10:59 a.m. that day, a 119 report was received regarding an explosion at Hanwha Aerospace's Daejeon plant in Oesam-dong, Yuseong-gu, Daejeon, and fire authorities are conducting extinguishing operations. (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 이날 “이 대통령이 사고 원인을 철저히 조사하고 추후 재발 방지 대책도 마련할 것을 지시했다”고 밝혔다. 이날 오전 10시59분 대전 유성구 외삼동 한화에어로스페이스 대전공장에서 폭발 사고가 발생했다는 119 신고가 접수됐고, 소방당국이 진화 작업을 벌이고 있다.)

item.title: Foreign Minister Cho Says Korea-Africa Cooperation More Important Amid Middle East Instability (조현 외교장관 “중동 불안정 속 한국-아프리카 협력 더 중요해져”)
item.description:
Foreign Minister Cho emphasized that cooperation between Korea and Africa has become more critical amid global uncertainties in the Middle East and growing instability in supply chains, energy, and food security. (조현 외교부 장관은 중동 정세의 불확실성과 공급망·에너지·식량 안보의 불안이 커진 세계정세에서 한국과 아프리카 간 협력이 더욱 중요해졌다고 강조했다.)

In his opening remarks at the Korea-Africa Foreign Ministers’ Meeting held at the Lotte Hotel in Seoul on the 1st, Minister Cho stated, "With continued instability in the Middle East and ongoing uncertainties surrounding the Strait of Hormuz, African countries are gaining greater geopolitical and economic importance on the international stage," clearly expressing his commitment to expanding cooperation with African nations. Minister Cho also noted that President Lee Jae-myung has demonstrated a willingness to cooperate through meetings with leaders from major African countries such as Egypt, South Africa, and Ghana shortly after taking office last year. ( 조 장관은 1일 서울 롯데호텔에서 열린 한-아프리카 외교장관회의 개회사에서 “중동 지역의 지속적인 불안정과 호르무즈 해협을 둘러싼 불확실성이 계속되는 가운데, 아프리카 국가들은 국제무대에서 지정학적·경제적 중요성이 더욱 커지고 있다”면서 아프리카 국가들과의 협력을 확대하겠다는 의지를 분명히 했다. 조 장관은 이재명 대통령이 지난해 취임 직후부터 이집트·남아프리카공화국·가나 등 아프리카 주요국가 정상들과 회담을 하며 협력 의지를 보였다고도 밝혔다. )

Minister Cho remarked, "Africa is the world’s youngest continent with immense growth potential, widely regarded as the 'continent of the future.' It is located at the crossroads of key maritime routes connecting the Atlantic, Indian Ocean, and Gulf of Aden, and is estimated to hold about 30% of the world’s critical mineral reserves." ( 조 장관은 “아프리카는 막대한 성장 잠재력을 보유한 세계에서 가장 젊은 대륙으로서, 널리 ‘미래의 대륙’으로 평가받고 있다”면서 “아프리카는 대서양, 인도양, 아덴만을 연결하는 주요 해상 교통로의 교차점에 위치해 있으며, 전 세계 핵심 광물 매장량의 약 30%를 보유하고 있는 것으로 추정된다”고 말했다.)

Minister Cho also expressed his intention to share Korea’s experience of developing its economy and democracy in a short period from the devastation of war, when its per capita gross national income (GNI) was only $67. He cited an East African proverb, "When spider webs unite, they can tie up a lion," adding, "The challenges we face today can be addressed more effectively when Korea and Africa combine their respective experiences and strengths." ( 조 장관은 한국이 과거 1인당 국민총소득(GNI)이 67달러에 불과한 전쟁의 폐허 속에서 짧은 기간에 경제·민주주의를 발전시켰던 경험을 아프리카의 파트너들과 공유하겠다는 뜻도 밝혔다. 그는 ‘거미줄도 함께 모이면 사자를 묶을 수 있다’는 동아프리카 속담을 언급하며 “오늘날 우리가 직면한 도전들은 한국과 아프리카가 각자의 경험과 강점을 함께 모을 때 더 효과적으로 대응할 수 있다”고 덧붙였다.)

The Korea-Africa Foreign Ministers’ Meeting, which opened this day, was attended by foreign minister-level officials from 50 African countries and representatives from four regional organizations: the African Union (AU), the African Development Bank (AfDB), the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA), and the Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). This marks the first time Korea has invited all African countries and regional international organizations as a group to hold a meeting. ( 이날 개막한 한-아프리카 외교장관회의에는 아프리카 대륙의 50개국 외교장관급 인사들과 4개 지역기구인 아프리카연합(AU)·아프리카개발은행(AfDB)·아프리카대륙자유무역지대(AfCFTA)·아프리카 질병통제예방센터(CDC)가 참여했다. 한국이 아프리카 지역 국가 전체와 지역국제기구를 단독으로 초청해 회의를 개최한 것은 이번이 처음이다.)

Africa has recently drawn attention for its strategic value due to oil supply disruptions from the U.S.-Iran conflict, U.S.-China tensions, and the rise of protectionism. The presidential office Cheong Wa Dae announced on the 1st that President Lee Jae-myung would meet with about 20 minister-level officials from African countries who visited Korea for the meeting on the 2nd to discuss ways to enhance Korea-Africa cooperation. ( 아프리카는 최근 미-이란전쟁으로 인한 원유 공급 차질과 미·중 갈등, 보호무역주의 강화 등으로 그 전략적 가치가 주목받고 있다. 이재명 대통령은 2일 이번 회의 참석을 위해 방한한 아프리카 국가들의 장관급 인사 20여명을 접견하고 한국과 아프리카의 협력 증진 방안들을 논의한다고 청와대가 1일 밝혔다.)

The Foreign Ministers’ Meeting, held under the theme "Korea-Africa Partnership for Joint Response in a Global Transition Period," featured its first session on "Strengthening Economic Cooperation" and a second session on "Joint Response to Global Challenges: Korea-Africa Solidarity." The Ministry of Foreign Affairs plans to adopt a outcome document summarizing the discussions. The document is expected to outline the direction of Korea-Africa cooperation based on shared prosperity centered on economic cooperation and future growth engines, as well as joint responses to global challenges. (‘글로벌 전환기 속 공동 대응을 위한 한-아프리카 파트너십’을 주제로 열린 1일 외교장관 회의에서 첫 세션은 ‘경제협력 강화’를 의제로 세션 2는 ‘글로벌 도전에 대한 공동 대응: 한-아프리카 연대’를 의제로 진행됐다. 외교부는 이번 회의에서 논의된 내용을 담은 결과 문서도 채택할 계획이다. 이 문서에는 경제협력과 미래 성장동력을 주제로 한 공동 번영, 글로벌 도전 과제에 대한 공동 대응을 토대로 하는 한-아프리카 협력 방향 등의 내용이 담길 것으로 보인다.)

On the 2nd, a Korea-Africa Business Forum will be held as a side event to the Foreign Ministers’ Meeting, with around 300 participants including business leaders, government officials, and diplomats from Korea and Africa. After Minister Cho’s opening remarks, keynote speeches will be delivered by Sung Kim, President of Hyundai Motor’s Strategic Planning Division, and Wamkele Mene, Secretary-General of the AfCFTA. ( 2일에는 외교장관회의 부대 행사로 한국과 아프리카의 기업인, 정부 인사, 외교 인사 등 300여 명이 참석하는 한-아프리카 비즈니스 포럼이 개최된다. 조 장관의 개회사에 이어 성 김 현대차 전략기획담당사장, 웸켈레 메네 AfCFTA 사무총장이 각각 기조연설을 한다.)

Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr ( 박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Hanwha Aerospace Explosion Accident…Rival Parties Ban Campaign Slogan Songs and Dance Moves (한화에어로 폭발 사고에…여야, 선거 로고송·율동 금지)
item.description:
In connection with the fatal explosion accident that occurred on the 1st at the Hanwha Aerospace plant in Daejeon, political parties, with just two days left until the June 3 local elections, have decided to ban the use of campaign slogan songs and dance moves during electioneering, and to suspend or scale back their campaign rallies. (1일 대전 한화에어로스페이스 공장에서 발생한 폭발 사망 사고와 관련해, 6·3 지방선거를 이틀 앞둔 정당들은 선거운동 과정에서 로고송 사용과 율동을 금지하고, 유세를 중단 또는 축소하기로 했다.)

Jung Cheong-rae, the leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, issued an urgent directive, stating, “All Democratic Party candidates and campaign teams nationwide are to ban the use of slogan songs and dance moves, as well as suspend campaign rallies.” Jang Dong-hyuk, the leader of the People Power Party, issued an urgent directive stating, “All People Power Party candidates and campaign teams nationwide are to refrain from using slogan songs and dance moves, and proceed with a subdued election campaign.” Cho Kuk, the leader of the Rebuilding Korea Party, also issued an urgent directive to all candidates and campaign teams nationwide to prohibit the use of slogan songs and dance moves, urging them to “conduct calm campaign rallies and, if possible, phone-based electioneering.” The New Reform Party requested “to proceed with election campaigning in a calm manner,” and the Justice Party also set a policy of refraining from using slogan songs and dance moves. <<> Jeong Won-oh, the Democratic Party candidate running for Seoul mayor, temporarily suspended his campaign rallies, and Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate, also stated, “Today’s campaign rallies will proceed on a calm and quiet schedule.” <<> At 10:59 a.m. on this day, an explosion accident occurred at the Hanwha Aerospace Daejeon plant in Yuseong-gu, Daejeon, resulting in five people injured and two fatalities. <<> Lee Ji-eun, Reporter jieuny@hani.co.kr (정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 “전국의 민주당 후보와 캠프는 로고송 사용과 율동 금지는 물론, 유세를 중단하라”고 긴급 지시했다. 장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 “전국 국민의힘 후보와 선거 캠프는 로고송 사용과 율동을 자제하고, 차분한 선거 운동을 진행할 것”을 긴급 지시했다. 조국 조국혁신당 대표도 전국 후보와 선거 캠프에 로고송 사용과 율동 등을 금지할 것을 긴급 지시하고, “차분한 유세, 가능한 전화 선거운동을 하라”고 당부했다. 개혁신당은 “차분한 기조 속에 선거운동을 진행해 달라”고 당부했고, 정의당도 로고송과 율동 자제 방침을 내렸다.)

item.title: “We’re All in This Together, Time to Stop”… Democratic Party Lawmakers from TK Region Appeal for Support for Kim Boo-kyum (“우리가 남이가, 이제 그만”…TK 출신 민주당 의원들, 김부겸 지지 호소)
item.description:
Lawmakers from the Democratic Party who are either from the Daegu region or have connections with Kim Boo-kyum, the Democratic Party’s candidate for Daegu mayor, appealed to voters in Daegu, saying, “For this election, please look at the person, not the party,” urging support for Kim. (대구 지역 출신이거나 김부겸 더불어민주당 대구시장 후보와 인연이 있는 민주당 의원들이 대구지역 유권자들을 향해 “이번만큼은 정당이 아닌 인물을 봐달라”며 김 후보에 대한 지지를 호소했다.)

On the 1st, Han Jeong-ae, chair of the Democratic Party’s Policy Committee; Kwon Chil-seung, co-chair of Kim’s campaign committee; along with lawmakers Lee Jae-jeong, Park Hae-cheol, and Im Mi-ae, and spokesperson Jang Yoon-mi held a press conference at the National Assembly Communication Hall, stating, “We earnestly ask you to give one last chance to Candidate Kim, who is ready to dedicate himself solely to Daegu’s development, to work for Daegu.” (민주당 한정애 정책위의장과 김 후보 캠프 공동선대위원장인 권칠승 의원, 이재정·박해철·임미애 의원, 장윤미 대변인은 1일 국회 소통관에서 기자회견을 열어 “오직 대구 발전을 위해 헌신할 준비가 돼 있는 김 후보에게 대구를 위해 일할 마지막 기회를 주시기를 간절하게 청한다”고 밝혔다.)

In the press statement, they said, “The essence of this election is very clear,” adding, “It is not about outdated factional logic or blind party-line voting. It is an election to choose whether to revive Daegu’s economy, which has collapsed beyond repair, or to sink deeper into a quagmire of stagnation.” (이들은 기자회견문에서 “이번 선거의 본질은 너무나 명확하다”며 “낡은 진영 논리나 맹목적인 정당 투표가 아니다. 무너질 대로 무너진 대구 경제를 회복시킬 것인가, 아니면 더 깊은 침체의 수렁 속으로 빠져들 것인가를 선택하는 선거”라고 했다.)

They noted, “For the long period of the past 30 years, the People Power Party and its predecessor parties have enjoyed a political monopoly in Daegu with virtually no checks or competition,” and added, “The report card of this one-party monopoly is truly devastating. For 30 years, the shameful label of ranking last in the nation in per capita GRDP (Gross Regional Domestic Product) has been attached to Daegu’s name.” (이들은 “지난 30년이라는 긴 시간 동안, 국민의힘과 그 전신 정당들은 대구에서 사실상 아무런 견제와 경쟁없이 정치적 독점을 누려왔다”며 “일당 독점의 성적표는 너무나도 참혹하다. 30년째 1인당 지알디피(GRDP·지역내총생산) 전국 최하위라는 불명예스러운 꼬리표가 대구 이름 뒤에 붙어 다닌다”고 했다.)

They continued, “How much longer must we cover up this dire reality with the phrase ‘We’re all in this together’? Daegu should no longer be confined to the distorted, narrow framework of being a specific party’s ‘home turf’ or the ‘heart of conservatism.’” (그러면서 “언제까지 이 참담한 현실을 ‘우리가 남이가’라는 말 한마디로 덮고 가야 하나. 대구는 더 이상 특정 정당의 ‘안방’이나 ‘보수의 심장’이라는 왜곡된 좁은 틀에 갇혀 있어서는 안 된다”고 했다.)

Regarding the opposing candidate, Choo Kyung-ho of the People Power Party running for Daegu mayor, they stated, “He is not only a figure representing the monopolistic party that has ruined Daegu’s economy over the past 30 years, but he is also indicted on the serious charge of ‘engaging in important duties related to insurrection’ and is standing before the court. He may even have to travel to the criminal courtroom of the Seoul Central District Court almost every week to attend his trial.” (상대 후보인 추경호 국민의힘 대구시장 후보에 대해선 “지난 30년간 대구 경제를 망쳐온 독점 정당을 대변하는 인물일 뿐만 아니라, ‘내란중요임무종사’라는 무거운 혐의로 기소되어 법정 심판대에 올라 있는 상태다. 일주일이 멀다 하고 서울중앙지법 형사법정 피고인석에 앉아 재판을 받으러 다녀야 할지도 모른다”고 했다.)

They appealed, “Instead of a candidate who is a criminal defendant soon to face trial, please choose Kim Boo-kyum—a truly capable worker who is ready to work day and night, focusing only on Daegu’s citizens.” (이들은 “조만간 재판 받아야 하는 형사 피고인 후보 대신, 오직 대구 시민만을 바라보고 밤낮으로 일 할 준비가 된 능력있는 진짜 일꾼, 김부겸을 선택해달라”고 호소했다.)

After the press conference, lawmaker Kwon Chil-seung told reporters, “The on-the-ground atmosphere is even better than in the most Democratic-leaning areas of the metropolitan region,” and added, “There are both ‘shy conservatives’ and ‘shy Kim Boo-kyum supporters,’ but it seems there are slightly more ‘shy Kim supporters.’” Regarding the impact of former President Park Geun-hye’s campaign rally in Daegu, he said, “We don’t see it as affecting the election dynamics, but we view it as a regrettable, regressive act that sets politics back in Daegu,” and added, “I believe Daegu’s citizens will make a wise judgment.” (권칠승 의원은 기자회견을 마친 뒤 취재진에 “현장 분위기는 수도권에 민주당이 가장 우세한 지역보다도 더 좋은 분위기”라며 “‘샤이 보수’도 있고 ‘샤이 부겸’도 있다는데 ‘샤이 부겸’이 조금 더 많은 것 같다”고 했다. 박근혜 전 대통령의 대구 지원 유세 영향에 대해서는 “선거 판세에 영향 준다고 보고 있지 않지만 대구에 정치를 후퇴시키는 퇴행적 행태라는 안타까움을 가지고 있다”며 “대구시민들께서 현명한 판단해주실 거라 믿는다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, on the 1st, Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae ordered all party candidates to suspend their campaign activities in connection with an explosion that occurred at around 10:59 a.m. at Hanwha Aerospace’s Daejeon plant in Oesam-dong, Yuseong-gu, Daejeon. (한편 정청래 민주당 대표는 1일 오전 10시59분께 대전 유성구 외삼동 한화에어로스페이스 대전사업장에서 발생한 폭발 사고와 관련해 전국의 모든 후보에게 유세를 중단하도록 했다.)

item.title: Kwanhun Club Presents Plaque of Appreciation to U.S. Embassy in Seoul (관훈클럽, 주한미국대사관에 감사패 수여)
item.description:
The Kwanhun Club held an event on March 1 at the Korea Press Center in Seoul to present a plaque of appreciation to the U.S. Embassy in Seoul, marking the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States. The Kwanhun Club was established in 1957, centered on journalists who had received training in the United States with the support of the U.S. Embassy in Seoul and related U.S. government agencies after the Korean War. (관훈클럽은 1일 서울 한국프레스센터에서 미국 건국 250주년을 맞아 주한 미국대사관에 감사패를 주는 행사를 열었다. 관훈클럽은 6·25전쟁 이후 주한미국대사관과 미국 정부 관련 기관의 지원을 받아 미국 연수를 다녀온 언론인을 중심으로 1957년 창립됐다.)

Lee Ha-won, secretary general of the Kwanhun Club, said at the event, "We organized this event to express our gratitude for the friendship and support that the U.S. Embassy in Seoul has shown over a long period," adding, "Going forward, the Kwanhun Club will continue to serve as a bridge of friendship and cooperation between South Korea and the United States." James Heller, Deputy Chief of Mission at the U.S. Embassy, stated, "As the United States marks its 250th anniversary this year, celebrating this occasion with the Kwanhun Club makes it all the more meaningful." <<> Approximately 30 people attended the event, including Heller and other officials from the U.S. Embassy, Rep. Kim Kun of the People Power Party, and Jeong Yeon-doo, head of the Foreign Ministry's Office of Diplomatic Strategy and Information. <<> Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (이하원 관훈클럽 총무는 이날 행사에서 “주한 미국대사관이 오랜 기간 보여준 우정과 성원에 감사의 뜻을 전하고자 이번 행사를 마련했다”라며 “앞으로도 관훈클럽은 한미 양국 간 우호와 협력의 가교 역할을 이어가겠다”고 밝혔다. 제임스 헬러 미국 대사대리는 “미국이 올해 건국 250주년을 맞이한 시점에서 관훈클럽과 이를 기념하게 돼 더욱 뜻깊게 생각한다”라고 말했다.)

item.title: Lee Jun-seok on "Vote-Cutting" Controversy: "More Absurd than Jo Se-ho's 'No-Show' at Wedding" (‘투표 새치기 논란’ 이준석 “조세호 ‘결혼식 불참’보다 더 황당”)
item.description:
Lee Jun-seok, leader of the Reform Party, has repeatedly expressed his frustration over the "advance voting queue-jumping" controversy, stating, "It's more absurd than when Jo Se-ho was criticized for not attending a wedding and said, 'How could I go if I don't know the person?'" (이준석 개혁신당 대표가 ‘사전투표 새치기’ 논란에 거듭 억울해하며 “조세호씨가 결혼식 불참 지적을 받았을 때 ‘모르는 사람인데 어떻게 가냐’고 했던 것보다 더 황당하다”고 말했다.)

At the Reform Party's on-site central election campaign committee held in Incheon on the 1st, Lee said, "All I can say is, 'How can you line up when there is no line?'" (이 대표는 1일 인천에서 진행한 개혁신당 현장 중앙선거대책위원회에서 “‘줄이 없는데 어떻게 줄을 서냐’라고 밖에 말할 수 없는 상황”이라며 이같이 말했다.)

Earlier, on May 29, the first day of advance voting for the June 3 local elections, Lee visited an early voting station at the Dongtan 9-dong Administrative Welfare Center in Hwaseong, Gyeonggi Province, where a citizen confronted him, asking why he wasn't joining the queue. (앞서 이 대표는 6·3 지방선거 사전투표 첫날인 지난달 29일 경기 화성시 동탄9동 행정복지센터 사전투표소를 찾았다가 한 시민으로부터 ‘왜 줄을 서지 않느냐’는 취지의 항의를 받았다.)

In response, Lee insisted there was no waiting line at the time and announced legal action against accounts spreading claims that he had cut in line. (이에 이 대표는 당시 투표 대기 줄이 없었다면서, 자신이 새치기했다고 유포하는 계정들에 대해 법적 대응 방침을 밝힌 바 있다.)

On the same day, Lee pushed back again. "The facts are simple," he said. "A voter mistakenly thought from the wrong spot and asked, 'Why aren't you standing in line?' That's all there is to it." He added, "Spreading falsehoods takes just one click. But correcting them is impossible even with thousands of times the effort." (이 대표는 이날 또다시 반발했다. 이 대표는 “사실 관계는 단순하다”며 “한 유권자가 엉뚱한 위치에서 착각하시고 ‘왜 줄을 안 서느냐’고 하셨다. 그것이 전부다”라고 했다. 이어 “거짓을 퍼뜨리는 데에는 클릭 한 번이면 된다. (그러나) 그것을 바로잡는 것은 수천 배의 노력으로도 불가능하다”고 말했다.)

Lee noted, "The reason 'smear campaigns' haven't disappeared in the SNS era is precisely because of this tilted unfairness. Smaller parties are especially vulnerable to such tactics." (이 대표는 “에스엔에스(SNS) 시대에 마타도어가 사라지지 않는 이유가 바로 이 기울어진 불공평함에 있다”며 “특히 덩치가 작은 정당일수록 이런 공작에 내성이 약하다”고도 했다.)

"The broadcaster that first posted the video even removed it after checking the context. But netizens added strange subtitles, created an absurd 'queue-jumping' frame, and spread it," Lee said. "Correcting a single line of lies takes hundreds of times the effort. Even then, some wounds never heal." He added, "What can eliminate the place for smear campaigns? Wise citizens who seek out the exact truth, casting their votes with public sentiment that outweighs and extinguishes that malice—that's correcting the scars left by lies with ballots." (이 대표는 “영상을 처음 올린 방송사조차 전후 상황을 확인하고 곧바로 내렸다. 그런데 (누리꾼들이) 희한한 자막을 입혀 ‘새치기’라는 어이없는 프레임을 만들어 퍼뜨렸다”며 “한 줄로 지어진 거짓을 바로잡는 데에는 그 수백 배의 노력이 든다. 그러고도 어떤 상처는 끝내 회복되지 않는다”고 말했다. 이 대표는 “마타도어가 설 자리를 없애는 길은 무엇이겠냐. 정확히 사실을 알아보신 현명한 시민들께서 그 악의를 덮고도 남을 민의로 투표장에 나오시는 것”이라며 “거짓이 남긴 흠집을 표로 교정해 주시는 것”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Song Kyung-hwa freehwa@hani.co.kr (송경화 기자 freehwa@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon: "It Wasn't President MB Calling Someone a 'Bad Person'" – Park Min-shik: "There Were Even More Specific Remarks" (한동훈 “‘나쁜 사람’ MB 말 아냐” 박민식 “더 구체적인 말도 있어”)
item.description:
On the 1st, Park Min-shik, the People Power Party candidate for the June 3rd by-election in Busan's Buk-gu district, and independent candidate Han Dong-hoon engaged in a war of words over who former President Lee Myung-bak's recent "bad person" comment referred to during his visit to Busan. Meanwhile, Ha Jung-woo, the Democratic Party candidate, kept his distance from the two candidates' power struggle to capture conservative voters in the final stretch, continuing a "stealth" campaign. <<> Candidate Han held a press conference at his Busan Buk-gu election office that day, stating that former President Lee's "bad person" comment "was not something former President Lee said." This was a rebuttal to Park, who after meeting former President Lee during his Busan visit on May 31st, posted on Facebook: "'Fight to the end. If a good person fights a bad person, you must win. You will definitely win.' Today, former President Lee Myung-bak firmly grasped my hand and stressed this two or three times," effectively implying that the "bad person" was Han. Han further said to Park, "I don't understand why you keep going elsewhere when this is an election for Buk-gu." Former President Lee had visited Busan to campaign for People Power Party Busan mayoral candidate Park Hyung-joon in the June 3rd local elections, and Han's remark appeared to criticize Park for meeting former President Lee in Haeundae-gu rather than Buk-gu. <<> In response, Park countered at a press conference at his Buk-gu election office: "(Former President Lee) is the greatest elder in our conservative camp. If I carelessly distorted the words of such a person, that would be political impropriety. I wrote down former President Lee's words verbatim," and added, "In fact, there were even more specific remarks, but I'll hold back." <<> Ha Jung-woo, the Democratic Party candidate, maintained his distance from the fierce verbal clash between the conservative candidates, continuing a "stealth" campaign that emphasized his own suitability, as the ruling party's candidate, for developing Buk-gu. At a press conference in the Busan City Council briefing room that day, when asked by reporters about former President Lee's Busan visit and the "conservative rebuilding" dispute between Park and Han, Ha said, "We need to re-examine how agendas like conservative unity or conservative rebuilding can contribute to solving Buk-gu's pressing issues," and added, "What Buk-gu needs right now is not ideological debate." <<> Reported by Jo Hee-yeon and Ko Han-sol, choh@hani.co.kr (6·3 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 박민식 국민의힘 후보와 한동훈 무소속 후보가 최근 부산을 방문한 이명박 전 대통령의 ‘나쁜 사람’ 발언이 누구를 지칭한 것인지를 두고 1일 신경전을 벌였다. 하정우 더불어민주당 후보는 막판 보수층 표심을 잡기 위한 두 후보의 기싸움에 거리를 두고 ‘스텔스’ 선거 운동을 이어갔다.)

item.title: Democratic Party says “humbly,” People Power Party says “we reflect” — lowering their stance while continuing attacks on “corrupt practices” and “arrogance” (민주 “겸손하게” 국힘 “반성한다” 몸 낮추며 “적폐” “오만” 공세 계속)
item.description:
On June 1st, two days before the June 3rd local elections and by-elections for National Assembly seats, the Democratic Party and the People Power Party both lowered their stance to appeal to voters. (6·3 지방선거와 국회의원 재보궐선거를 이틀 앞둔 1일, 더불어민주당과 국민의힘이 서로 몸을 낮추며 표심에 호소했다.)

The Democratic Party’s Central Election Committee’s General Election Strategy Headquarters (led by Headquarters Chief Cho Seung-rae) announced that from 6 a.m., they would switch to a “60-hour emergency operations room system.” During this period, the Headquarters notified all party members of codes of conduct, stating, “Thoroughly guard against inappropriate words and actions that may appear complacent or arrogant, and convey urgency to voters with a low and humble attitude.” This was aimed at preventing decisive mistakes, such as slip-ups, in the final stretch of the campaign. (민주당 중앙당 선거대책위원회 총괄선거대책본부장실(본부장 조승래)은 이날 아침 6시부터 ‘60시간 상황실 비상가동체제’로 전환한다고 밝혔다. 선대본부장실은 이 기간 전 당원들에게 “자만하거나 오만하게 비칠 수 있는 부적절한 언행을 철저히 경계하고, 낮고 겸손한 자세로 유권자들에게 절실함을 전달한다”는 행동 수칙을 공지했다. 선거 막바지 설화 등 결정적인 실수를 할 가능성을 단속한 것이다.)

The People Power Party lowered their stance in a “reflection” mode. (국민의힘은 ‘반성’ 모드로 몸을 낮췄다.)

Floor Leader Song Eon-seok held a press briefing at the National Assembly to appeal to the public, saying, “We are well aware that the public views the People Power Party as being very lacking, and we feel sorry and reflect on that.” He added, “Shouldn’t we press the control button once for the ruling forces intoxicated by the taste of power?” Policy Committee Chairman Jeong Jeom-sik also said, “We reflect profoundly on the People Power Party’s shortcomings. We will reform and change with a lower stance and more desperately. Please, be sure to come out to the main polling station.” (송언석 원내대표는 국회에서 대국민 호소 기자간담회를 열어 “국민의힘이 많이 부족하다고 보시는 것을 잘 알고 있고, 송구하게 생각하고 반성한다”며 “권력의 맛에 도취한 집권 세력에게 제어 버튼 한번 눌러줘야 하지 않느냐”라고 말했다. 정점식 정책위의장도 “국민의힘이 부족했던 점을 뼈저리게 반성한다. 더 낮은 자세로 더 처절하게 쇄신하고 변화하겠다”며 “반드시 본투표장에 나와달라”고 했다.)

Amid this, the leaders of both parties continued their harsh attacks on each other. (이런 가운데서도 양당 대표는 상대를 향해 거친 공세를 이어갔다.)

Democratic Party Leader Jeong Cheong-rae said during a Central Election Committee meeting in Cheonan, South Chungcheong Province, “This election will be a grand prelude to breaking away from the old ways, corrupt practices, and insurgent forces that are eating away at South Korea, and moving toward a great leap forward.” Referring to former Presidents Lee Myung-bak and Park Geun-hye, who have supported People Power Party candidates, and the imprisoned former President Yoon Seok-youl, he called them the “prison trio” and said, “We must extinguish the embers of the insurgency that is stirring.” (정청래 민주당 대표는 충남 천안에서 열린 중앙선대위 회의에서 “이번 선거는 대한민국을 좀먹는 구태·적폐·내란 세력과 단절하고 대도약으로 나아가는 장대한 서막이 될 것”이라고 했다. 그는 국민의힘 후보 지원에 나선 이명박·박근혜 전 대통령과 수감 중인 윤석열 전 대통령을 묶어 “감옥 3인방”이라며 “준동하는 내란의 잔불을 제거해야 한다”고 말했다.)

People Power Party Leader Jang Dong-hyuk also wrote on Facebook, “Democratic Party’s Jeong Cheong-rae said, ‘If you made money from stocks, vote for the Democratic Party,’ which is a truly arrogant remark that ignores the people.” He added, “We must judge Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party for destroying livelihoods. If you give up voting, an even harsher hell will begin.” (장동혁 국민의힘 대표도 페이스북에 올린 글에 “민주당 정청래는 ‘주식 해서 돈 벌었으면 민주당에 투표하라’고 하는데, 국민을 무시하는 참으로 오만한 발언”이라며 “이재명과 민주당의 민생 파탄을 심판해야 한다. 투표를 포기하면 더 혹독한 지옥이 시작될 것”이라고 썼다.)

item.title: Election D-2, President Lee Emphasizes 'Real Estate Normalization'… "No Illegal Speculation" (선거 D-2, 이 대통령 ‘부동산 정상화’ 강조…“불법투기 안 돼”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 1st, "We must definitely escape the ruinous republic of unearned real estate income." It has been 11 days since President Lee last posted a message related to real estate. With real estate emerging as a major issue in the June 3 local elections, this appears to be a renewed emphasis on his commitment to normalizing the real estate market. (이재명 대통령이 1일 “망국적인 부동산 불로소득 공화국은 반드시 탈출할 것”이라고 말했다. 이 대통령이 부동산 관련 메시지를 직접 올린 것은 11일 만이다. 부동산이 6·3 지방선거 주요 쟁점이 된 가운데 부동산 정상화 의지를 다시 한번 강조한 것으로 보인다.)

On this day, President Lee shared an article titled "Up to 4 billion won in rewards, reports surge… 8 out of 10 real estate tax evasion reports from the Seoul metropolitan area" on X (formerly Twitter), stating, "Tax evasion through illegal real estate speculation is no longer acceptable." The article noted that 8 out of 10 reports received by the National Tax Service's 'Real Estate Tax Evasion Reporting Center' were concentrated in Seoul, Gyeonggi, and Incheon. The National Tax Service pays informants who provide crucial data leading to tax collections of 50 million won or more up to 4 billion won in rewards, depending on the amount of tax evaded. (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 “부동산 불법투기 탈세, 이제는 안 된다”며 ‘최대 40억 포상금에 신고 폭주…부동산 탈세 제보 10건 중 8건 수도권’이라는 제목의 기사를 공유했다. 이 기사는 국세청이 운영 중인 ‘부동산 탈세 신고 센터’에 접수된 제보 10건 중 8건이 서울·경기·인천 등에 집중됐다는 내용이었다. 국세청은 제보자가 중요 자료를 제공해 5천만원 이상 세금이 추징되면 탈루 세액에 따라 최대 40억원의 포상금을 지급한다.)

President Lee had previously refrained from commenting on the most sensitive issue of real estate ahead of the local elections. His last message related to real estate was on the 21st, when he refuted an article claiming that 'a Chinese national bought 944 apartments in Seoul's Gangnam,' writing, "Between January and April, only 5 Chinese nationals purchased collective buildings in Gangnam-gu." President Lee's renewed real estate message after 11 days is interpreted as an attempt to emphasize the government's commitment to normalizing the real estate market, amid the opposition party highlighting real estate issues as an election talking point. A Blue House official stated, "This reiterates the strong will to normalize illegal activities in real estate." (이 대통령은 그동안 지방선거를 앞두고 가장 예민한 부동산 문제에 대해선 언급을 자제해왔다. 지난 21일 ‘중국인이 서울 강남 아파트 944채를 매수했다’는 기사를 반박하며 “1~4월간 강남구 집합건물 중국인 매수는 5명에 불과하다”고 쓴 게 마지막 부동산 관련 메시지였다. 이 대통령이 11일 만에 부동산 관련 메시지를 다시 낸 것은 야당이 부동산 문제를 선거 쟁점으로 부각하는 상황에서 정부의 부동산 시장 정상화 의지를 강조하려는 의도로 풀이된다. 청와대 관계자는 “부동산 불법행위에 대한 정상화 의지가 강하다는 것을 재차 강조한 것”이라고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, President Lee also voiced his opinions on the stock market on this day. Sharing an article stating that the KOSPI index would be 4100 excluding semiconductors, he said, "Semiconductors are one of the core industries of our country, so I find it hard to understand why we need to calculate the composite stock index excluding them." He added, "People don't say, 'Excluding his soccer skills, Son Heung-min is just an ordinary person?' Rather, shouldn't it be, 'Even excluding semiconductors, the Korean stock market is a whopping 4100'?" On that day, the KOSPI closed at 8788.38, reaching an all-time high. <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (한편, 이 대통령은 이날 증시와 관련해서도 목소리를 냈다. 반도체를 빼면 코스피 지수가 4100이라는 기사를 공유하며 “반도체가 우리 산업의 핵심 중 하나인데, 왜 반도체를 빼고 종합주가지수를 계산해야 하는지 이해가 잘 안된다”고 말했다. 그러면서 이 대통령은 “‘축구 실력 빼면 손흥민도 보통 사람?’ 이러는 사람 없다”며 “오히려 ‘반도체 빼고도 한국 증시 무려 4100’ 이래야 하는 거 아니냐”고 말했다. 이날 코스피는 8788.38로 거래를 마치며 사상 최고치를 경신했다.)

item.title: Ruling and Opposition Parties Keep Campaigns 'As Quiet as Possible' After Hanwha Aerospace Accident in Daejeon (대전 한화 에어로 사고에 여야 선거운동 ‘최대한 조용히’)
item.description:
On June 1, two days before the June 3 local elections, the ruling and opposition parties either completely halted or ordered a restraint on noisy campaigning nationwide after the explosion and fatal accident at Hanwha Aerospace in Daejeon. (6·3 지방선거를 이틀 앞둔 1일, 여야는 대전 한화에어로스페이스 폭발 사망 사고가 발생하자 전국 선거운동을 전면 중단하거나 요란한 선거운동을 자제하도록 했다.)

The Democratic Party of Korea announced through a media notice on the same day that "Party leader Chung Cheong-rae has urgently instructed all candidates' camps nationwide to stop using campaign songs and choreography, as well as to suspend all campaign rallies." In response, campaign camps including that of Seoul mayoral candidate Jung Won-oh immediately temporarily suspended electioneering. Party leader Chung halted his own campaign schedule and visited the accident site in Daejeon around 5 p.m. that day. Cho Kuk, candidate for the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, also stated via a media notice, "Instead of standing on campaign vehicles and grabbing the microphone, we will quietly and calmly meet voters directly." (더불어민주당은 이날 낮 언론 공지를 통해 “정청래 당대표는 사고와 관련해서 전국의 민주당 후보 캠프에 로고송 사용과 율동 금지는 물론, 전국 모든 후보들에게 유세 중단을 긴급 지시했다”고 밝혔다. 이에 따라 정원오 서울시장 후보 캠프 등 각 캠프는 곧장 선거 유세를 잠정 중단했다. 정 대표는 유세 일정을 중단하고 이날 오후 5시께 대전 사고 현장을 찾았다. 조국 조국혁신당 후보도 언론 공지를 통해 “유세차에 올라 마이크를 잡는 대신, 조용하게 차분하게 유권자들을 직접 찾아 뵙겠다”고 했다.)

The People Power Party's central election committee announced that party leader Jang Dong-hyuk also "urgently instructed all candidates and campaign camps nationwide to refrain from using campaign songs and choreography and to conduct restrained campaigning." Party leader Jang visited the Daejeon accident site around 7 p.m. that evening. The campaign of Seoul mayoral candidate Oh Se-hoon canceled a scheduled press conference in the afternoon, stating that "the campaign will proceed with a calm and quiet schedule." The Reform Party and the Justice Party also urged their candidates nationwide to refrain from using campaign songs and choreography. (장동혁 국민의힘 대표도 “전국 국민의힘 후보와 선거 캠프에 로고송 사용과 율동을 자제하고 차분한 선거운동을 진행할 것”을 긴급 지시했다고 당 중앙선거대책위원회가 밝혔다. 장 대표도 이날 저녁 7시께 대전 사고 현장을 찾았다. 오세훈 서울시장 후보 캠프는 오후 예정된 기자회견을 취소하면서 “유세는 차분하고 조용한 일정으로 진행한다는 방침”이라고 밝혔다. 개혁신당과 정의당 등도 전국 후보들에게 로고송 사용과 율동을 자제할 것을 주문했다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr 최하얀 기자 chy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Unification attempt collapses amid 'Fake Democratic Party' emotional clash… extreme conflict between Cho Kuk and Kim Yong-nam (‘가짜 민주당’ 감정싸움 끝에 단일화 무산…조국-김용남 ‘극한 갈등’)
item.description:
The verbal sparring between Kim Yong-nam, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for the Pyeongtaek-eul by-election, and Cho Kuk, the candidate for the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, has escalated into a near-mutual slander brawl, deepening the rift between the two parties. <<> Lee Hae-min, the general head of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party's election campaign committee, held a press briefing at the National Assembly on the 1st, saying, "In Pyeongtaek, a year ago, someone who wore red clothes for a long time, then briefly put on orange clothes, and when he wasn't nominated (there), changed into blue clothes is acting as a fake Democratic Party candidate. His value is not Lee Jae-myung's value, but power and money," adding, "This perfectly suits a chameleon-like former prosecutor candidate who changed party affiliations chasing power and nominations here and there." This was a direct strike at Kim Yong-nam, a former prosecutor who moved his party affiliation from the People Power Party to the Reform Party and then to the Democratic Party. <<> Kim Yong-nam's campaign also issued a commentary, strongly criticizing Cho Kuk for acting as a 'fake Democratic Party' candidate. <<> In the commentary, Kim's campaign said, "If Cho Kuk can just hang a party badge, it's not surprising that he would sacrifice his pride and act like a pseudo-candidate of another party," and "As for the so-called 'self-reliant first place' strategy that Cho mentioned, no matter how you look at it—like 'acting like a fake Democrat,' 'impersonating a democracy camp candidate,' 'merging with the Democratic Party,' or 'negative campaigning against the Democratic Party candidate'—it's natural that there's nothing of their own, which is almost pitiful." The campaign also brought up past sexual assault cases within the Innovation Party regarding the merger with the Democratic Party that Cho's side had left open, criticizing, "Unless he's a psychopath, I don't know why he keeps pushing. Even though we clearly expressed our refusal, persistently courting is also sexual violence. It seems they don't realize this, perhaps because they are the 'Sexual Assault Party.'" <<> The two parties also engaged in a war of nerves over the 'merger' issue. <<> Cho Kuk has consistently expressed the stance that if elected, he will lead a merger with the Democratic Party. However, the Democratic Party has drawn a line, stating that Cho's election outcome is irrelevant to the merger. Cho Seung-rae, the general election campaign chief, said, "There was a debate within the party about the merger with the Innovation Party last time, and we agreed to postpone discussions until after the local elections," adding, "Cho's election outcome has nothing to do with the merger discussions. (Cho's claim that no merger is possible if he loses is a forced argument.)" Supreme Council member Hwang Myeong-sun also said, "We are not considering a merger between the Democratic Party and the Innovation Party after the elections." Within the Democratic Party, many members, particularly among the pro-Lee Jae-myung faction, harbor aversion to Cho Kuk, who served as Minister of Justice during the Moon Jae-in administration. <<> Amid this, a unified candidate from the conservative camp in Pyeongtaek-eul is also becoming difficult. <<> Yoo Eui-dong, the People Power Party candidate for Pyeongtaek-eul, appeared on SBS Radio today and said to Hwang Kyo-ahn of the Liberty and Innovation Party, "The voices of local voters are so intense it's almost frightening. I will make efforts until the last moment for unification." However, Hwang posted on Facebook, "(Yoo) is someone who betrayed former President Park Geun-hye and supported her impeachment, even though the Liberty Korea Party could have blocked the impeachment decision if they had stuck together," adding, "Moreover, he still insists that siding with the impeachment was the right thing to do." <<> Reporters: Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr, Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr (경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에 나선 김용남 더불어민주당 후보와 조국 조국혁신당 후보 사이의 설전이 상호 비방에 가까운 난타전 양상으로 치달으며 두 당의 골이 깊어지고 있다.)
