item.title: Chungcheong ‘Central Plains Blitz’ Takes Center Stage… Jeong Cheong-rae and Jang Dong-hyuk Skip Busan (‘중원 바람몰이’ 충청 총력전…정청래·장동혁, 부산엔 안갔다)
item.description:
During the official campaign period for the June 3 local elections, it was revealed that Jeong Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, and Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, allocated the most time to the Chungcheong region, focusing on winning over voters in this battleground. The Chungcheong region, where fixed partisan loyalties are relatively weak, is considered a ‘political central plains’ that gauges the direction of public sentiment in every election. <<> ■ Jeong Cheong-rae Courts Chungcheong, Avoids Daegu, Busan, and Jeonbuk From May 21, when the official campaign began, to June 1, Jeong visited the Chungnam, Chungbuk, and Daejeon areas a total of 13 times over 12 days. On June 1 alone, he held an on-site central election strategy committee meeting in Cheonan, where the election office of Chungnam Governor candidate Park Su-hyun is located, and then moved to Goesan, Chungbuk, for a street rally. Jeong did not visit Daegu, Busan, or Ulsan, other key battlegrounds, even once, and only visited Gyeongnam once, showing relatively scant attention. This aligns with a strategy to promote the ‘candidate’s personal appeal’ in the conservative-leaning Yeongnam region’s competitive districts. A key official from the Democratic Party leadership told The Hankyoreh, “Under the principle of ‘going if the candidate requests it,’ we visited Chungcheong because candidates in competitive regional and local government races there asked for support. We didn’t visit Yeongnam because we judged that the candidates there have sufficient capabilities.” In Busan’s case, it appears that controversy also played a role, stemming from an incident on May 3, before the official campaign, when Jeong visited the Gupo Market with Ha Jung-woo, the Democratic Party candidate for the Busan Buk-gu by-election, and told a first-grade elementary school girl, “Say ‘Go for it, brother Jung-woo.’” <<> Jeong also visited Jeonbuk only once, where Democratic Party candidate Lee Won-taek and independent candidate Kim Kwan-young are competing. A Democratic Party lawmaker from the Jeonbuk region said, “Locally, there’s a sense that it’s actually better (for the Democratic Party’s election) if leader Jeong doesn’t come,” adding that following the ‘envelope money scandal’ that led to Kim’s exclusion from the nomination, “the wounds within the party should be left to heal, and constant meddling won’t help.” Jeong will conclude his campaign on June 2, the final day, starting in Jeongseon and Yeongwol in Gangwon Province, then moving through Gyeonggi Province and Seoul for rallies. <<> <<> ■ Jang Dong-hyuk, Shunned in Seoul, Also Focuses on Chungcheong As of today, Jang has visited the Chungcheong region eight times—four times in Chungnam, three in Daejeon, and once in Sejong—accounting for about a third of his official campaign schedule. Analysts suggest that Jang’s emphasis on campaigning in Chungnam is not unrelated to recent opinion polls showing the gap between the ruling and opposition candidates for Chungnam governor narrowing to single digits, signaling a tight race. <<> A party leadership official said, “The aim is to spark a wave in the Chungcheong central plains that will influence elections in the Seoul metropolitan area and Yeongnam regions.” Regarding Jang not visiting Busan, another battleground, even once, the official noted, “With conservatives rallying around former Presidents Park Geun-hye and Lee Myung-bak’s visits to Busan, there’s no need for Chairman Jang to go there and highlight potential conflict with candidate Han Dong-hoon.” <<> Chungcheong is also home to Jang’s own constituency (Boryeong-Seocheon, Chungnam). This has led to interpretations that his movements reflect a situation where he is unwelcome in other battlegrounds, due to his staunch conservative stance, including refusing to break ties with former President Yoon Seok-yeol. In fact, Jang planned a campaign support rally in Gangseo-gu, Seoul on May 26, but it was cancelled due to internal opposition. Seoul Mayor candidate Oh Se-hoon also did not request Jang’s election support during this campaign period and did not accompany him on his Seoul campaign trail. After starting his official campaign on the first day with a morning greeting rally in Daejeon, Jang plans to continue intensive campaigning in the Chungcheong region on the final day, June 2. <<> By Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr and Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (6·3 지방선거 공식 선거운동 기간 정청래 더불어민주당 대표와 장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 충청권에 가장 많은 일정을 할애하며 접전지 표심 잡기에 집중한 것으로 나타났다. 충청권은 특정 정당에 대한 고정 지지 성향이 상대적으로 약해 선거 때마다 민심의 향배를 가늠하는 ‘정치적 중원’으로 꼽힌다.)

item.title: President Lee says of government's ‘dollar forced sale’ rumor: "Must be strictly punished" (이 대통령, 정부 ‘달러 강제 매각설’ 거짓 유포에 “반드시 엄단”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 2nd, "Acts that cause social unrest and economic damage by deliberately spreading false information must be tracked down and strictly punished." (이재명 대통령이 2일 “고의적 허위사실 유포로 사회혼란, 경제피해를 야기하는 행위는 반드시 찾아내 엄단해야 한다”고 말했다.)

President Lee shared a media report in a post on X (formerly Twitter) that day about the police booking two additional individuals for spreading the ‘dollar forced sale’ rumor, and made this remark. Earlier, following the outbreak of the US-Israel/Iran war, false posts alleging that the government would forcibly sell dollars to respond to the Middle East-triggered economic crisis had spread online. (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 올린 글에서 경찰이 ‘달러 강제 매각설’ 유포자 2명을 추가로 입건했다는 내용의 언론 보도를 공유하며 이렇게 말했다. 앞서 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁이 발발하자 온라인상에 중동발 경제 위기에 대응하기 위해 정부가 달러를 강제로 매각하게 할 것이라는 내용의 허위 글이 확산했다.)

President Lee said, "Spreading false information that harms the public is neither freedom of expression nor a subject of tolerance." He added, "A prank? You call it a joke? Just as killing people and destroying the order and values of a community are serious crimes that must be severely punished even if done as a prank or joke, the same applies here." He continued, "I should send pizza to the hardworking police investigation team, shouldn’t I?" (이 대통령은 “공공에 피해를 입히는 허위사실 유포는 표현의 자유도 아니고, 포용의 대상도 아니다”라고 했다. 이어 “장난? 놀이라고요? 사람을 죽이고 공동체의 질서와 가치를 파괴하는 것은 장난이나 놀이로 했더라도 엄벌돼야 할 중대범죄인 것과 마찬가지”라며 “열일하는 경찰 수사팀에 피자라도 보내줘야겠지요?”라고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam, wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee to Drug Offenders: "Don't Waste Money Going to Prison, Get Treatment Instead" (이 대통령, 마약 사범에 “돈 쓰면서 교도소가지 말고, 치료받길”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 2nd, addressing drug offenders, "Don't bother spending money to go to prison; I hope you seek treatment early." (이재명 대통령이 2일 마약류 사범들을 향해 “공연히 돈 쓰면서 교도소 가지 마시고, 일찍 치료받길 바란다”고 말했다.)

President Lee shared an article on X (formerly Twitter) stating that the government, which has been waging a 'war on drugs,' arrested 5,386 online drug offenders over the past 10 months and seized 3,233 kilograms of drugs at border stages, and made this remark. (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 ‘마약과의 전쟁’ 벌인 정부가 10개월간 온라인 마약사범 5386명을 검거하고, 국경 단계에서 마약류 3233㎏를 적발했다는 기사를 공유하며 이렇게 밝혔다.)

President Lee said, "To all drug users, we have deployed drug enforcement agents to all domestic mail distribution centers to crack down on the social evil of drugs," and added, "Detection equipment such as the drug-sniffing dog 'Injo-ko' will also be installed." He continued, "If you purchase drugs by mail, you will definitely be caught and punished." (이 대통령은 “마약 투약 사범 여러분, 사회악인 마약 단속을 위해 모든 국내 우편집중국에 마약단속요원을 배치했다”며 “마약탐지견 ‘인조코’ 등 탐지장비도 설치한다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 이어 “우편으로 마약을 구입하면 반드시 적발돼 처벌된다”고 덧붙였다.)

Since December 29 of last year, the government has been piloting a 'double inspection' of drugs for mail destined for most areas of Seoul. It operates by having the Korea Customs Service conduct a first check at the customs screening stage, followed by a second inspection at mail distribution centers in cooperation between the Customs Service and the Korea Post. (정부는 지난해 12월29일부터 서울 대부분 지역으로 배송되는 우편물 대상 마약류 ‘이중검사’를 시범 실시하고 있다. 관세청이 세관 심사 단계에서 1차로 점검하고, 우편집중국에서 관세청과 우정사업본부가 협력해 2차 검사를 실시하는 방식으로 진행하고 있다.)

By Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)
